Definition: properly, a channel or fissure, i.e. (by implication) a cavern
BiblicalUsage: The word is a den, a fissure in the rock, and it appears once, when Midian oppressed Israel so hard that the people made themselves dens in the mountains and hid in caves and strongholds.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the dens tell the story of fear: a people who forget God end up hiding in the rocks, and Gideon found them there.
